postAttachCommand.server: bash -lc 'PID_FILE=/tmp/fe-exam-quiz-vite.pid; LOG_FILE=/tmp/fe-exam-quiz-vite.log; WORKSPACE_DIR=$(pwd -P); VITE_BIN="$WORKSPACE_DIR/node_modules/.bin/vite"; if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE"); if [ -n "$PID" ] && [ -d "/proc/$PID" ] && [ "$(readlink -f "/proc/$PID/cwd")" = "$WORKSPACE_DIR" ] && ps -p "$PID" -o args= | grep -F "$VITE_BIN --host 0.0.0.0" >/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; rm -f "$PID_FILE"; fi; "$VITE_BIN" --host 0.0.0.0 >"$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 & echo $! >"$PID_FILE"'
